full_name: Robert Huber | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2015–2016 Biological Sciences Helen Putnam Fellow Bowling Green State University
bio: Robert Huber, a professor in the Department of Biological Sciences at Bowling Green State University, explores the neurochemical basis of complex behavior associated with aggression and drug addiction.
